arguments.script: if(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name!="Level05_Cave")UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scenes/Level05_Cave.unity");var plan=UnityEngine.JsonUtility.FromJson<InstallJumpKingFifth.Plan>(System.IO.File.ReadAllText("scripts/jk-tilemap-20261111/plan.json"));var m=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().Single(m=>m.name.StartsWith("Jump King"));var tiles=new UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TileBase[]{UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.RuleTile>("Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Rock.asset"),UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tile>("Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Slope1.asset"),UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tile>("Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Slope2.asset"),UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tile>("Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Slope3.asset"),UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tile>("Assets/Tiles/JumpKingFifth/Slope4.asset")};foreach(var c in plan.cells)m.SetTile(new UnityEngine.Vector3Int(c.x,c.y,0),tiles[c.kind]);m.RefreshAllTiles();m.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TilemapCollider2D>().ProcessTilemapChanges();UnityEngine.Physics2D.SyncTransforms();UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene());UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene());System.IO.File.AppendAllText("scripts/jk-tilemap-20261111/applied.txt","\nFinal continuous-band slopes="+plan.cells.Count(c=>c.kind>0)+"; filled red-band interior cells="+plan.cells.Count(c=>c.kind==0));
